author: m. t. compton
title: Andrea Salinas addresses gun violence and food assistance cuts in recent tweets
text:
Congresswoman Andrea Salinas, who has represented Oregon’s 6th District in the U.S. Congress since 2023, posted a series of statements on her Twitter account on June 17, 2026, addressing issues ranging from child welfare to gun violence and food assistance.
In a post made at 20:57 UTC, Salinas commented on an unspecified incident with a brief statement: “This is child abuse.”
Later that evening, at 22:07 UTC, she marked Gun Violence Prevention Month by reflecting on its impact and her personal experiences as a parent. She wrote, “During Gun Violence Prevention Month, we remember those lost to gun violence and stand beside those whose lives were forever altered. As a mother, I remember the fear I felt when hearing my child’s school was on lockdown. That fear is far too common, and it’s why Congress must”.
At 23:38 UTC, Salinas addressed federal food assistance policy under the previous administration. She stated, “The Trump Administration ended food assistance for 70,000 Oregonians in just one year. Republicans have turned their back on hungry Oregonians.”
Salinas has served in Congress since 2023 after representing constituents in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023. Born in San Mateo, California in 1969 and currently residing in Tigard, she holds a BA from the University of California, Berkeley (1994).
